metadata.description: Doug's deterministic gates and plan-approve-implement flow for Claude Code

plugins.name: doug-gates
plugins.description: Deterministic guardrails for Claude Code: protected paths, bash guard, secret scan on edits and commands, format on edit, edit-loop detection, a verification gate on Stop and on SubagentStop, a snapshot of the plan and session into the anchor before compaction and re-anchoring after it, and a run trace of subagents and tool calls. Configured by .doug/config.json.

plugins.name: doug-flow
plugins.description: Plan, approve, implement one task per worktree, verify, review. A deterministic Workflow-tool template plus planner, implementer, verifier, and reviewer subagents. The plan is a file; nothing is implemented until you approve it.
